Rarity tier decides the price

Dragon Ball Super Card Game runs a steep rarity ladder, and the top tiers trade far above the common printings of the same character. Secret Rare and God Rare pulls are the cards that carry a set's value.

Scan candidates include catalog details such as set, card number and rarity. Confirm the matching card and finish in Review before checking its market price.

Leaders and alternate art are separate positions

Leader cards and alternate art treatments trade on their own, apart from the standard version at the same card number. Each is recorded as a distinct entry in your collection with its own value.

Track a set as it moves

Card AI keeps price history on individual cards and a running total across the collection, so you can see whether a set is appreciating rather than checking cards one at a time.
